title: Broken checkout in new API deploy
reason: The engineer correctly identified the API as the faulty component, linked the issue to the recent deploy, and described the null‑variable bug that caused the order‑placement failure.
option_titles: Rollback API to previous good version
root_cause: The API container was redeployed to version 2.3.2 55 minutes ago, and the new code contains a bug where a variable expected to be a string is None, causing a .strip() call to fail during order placement.
truth: api 2.3.2 introduced a regression in the order creation logic: a missing null check on the payment_token field causes an unhandled AttributeError on POST /api/orders, while read endpoints like /api/products still work.
